subject: Request: temporary SLA window for Nova Health VisionAssist beta
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@novahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SLA window for Nova Health VisionAssist beta

Sam / Lara —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. As we discussed, the VisionAssist beta will run on our new compact encoder + 4-bit quant path; early runs show great quality but higher variance in p95 latency under burst traffic. To keep your beta launch schedule, we’re proposing a short, mutually agreed SLA variance while we complete a targeted kernel optimization and ramp additional capacity.

High-level ask:
- Soft SLO window for 6 weeks starting March 20, 2028
- Uptime commitment: maintain 99.0% (instead of our standard 99.5%) for the beta slice
- Latency: allow p95 up to 450 ms for the beta model (standard p95 target is 300 ms for dedicated routes)
- Rollback triggers: if error-rate > 2% for 12h or sustained p95 > 800 ms for 3h we will auto-switch to VisionAssist-stable variant

Mitigations we are committing to:
- Dedicated canary pool for Nova Health traffic (isolated)
- Automated fallback to stable variant + notification hooks
- Live dashboard and alerting (link below) and a shared telemetry feed for your SREs

I've attached a concise proposal (SLO_variance_proposal_v1.pdf) and a fallback-model matrix. Please let us know if this is acceptable in principle; we will need an OK from your legal and exec sponsor to proceed and will route a short DocuSign amendment.

Would you prefer a 6-week window or an 8-week window? We can be flexible; 6 weeks is our engineering preference to keep the change scope tight.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SLO_variance_proposal_v1.pdf (pdf), fallback-model-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@novahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@novahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Mar 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA window for Nova Health VisionAssist beta

Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the detailed mitigations. A few clarifying items from our side before I take this to procurement and legal:

1) Monitoring hooks: can you provide a streaming telemetry endpoint or a CloudWatch-style feed for p50/p95/p99, error-rate and model-variant flag? Our SRE will want to ingest it directly.
2) Duration: prefer as short as possible; 6 weeks is OK if we see weekly checkpoints. Would request a formal review at week 2, 4, and final signoff at week 6.
3) Credits: if we hit the rollback triggers and you fail to remediate in the agreed window, what credits or fee offsets are we looking at? Even a provisional percentage helps procurement.
4) Legal: will need a one-paragraph amendment — can Neha coordinate with our counsel?

If we can get telemetry + a proposed credit schedule, I can push to sign within our window.

—Sam Carter
Head of Product & Partnerships
Nova Health
sam.carter@novahealth.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@novahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA window for Nova Health VisionAssist beta

Sam —

Thanks for the questions. Quick technical answers: 

1) Telemetry: we will expose a streaming telemetry webhook and a read-only Grafana dashboard. Endpoint: https://redwood.app/dashboards/NH-VisionAssist-Canary (read-only token in the attachment). We will also push CloudWatch-compatible metrics to an integration you configure.

2) Rollback / fallback behavior: the traffic router will switch to the VisionAssist-stable variant automatically and keep Canary pool warm. Failover is sub-30s for new sessions; existing in-flight sessions will finish on the canary model.

3) Remediation cadence: our on-call inference team will run 4-hour remediation windows during business hours and 12-hour on-call on weekends for the variance period. We will provide weekly notes and a short incident timeline for any issue that triggers the rollback triggers.

4) Credits: we can start with a provisional credit schedule: 10% service credit for a rollback trigger event where remediation exceeds the 4-hour window, 25% if we fail to restore capacity within 12 hours. This is a placeholder for legal to finalize.

I attached the fallback-model-matrix.xlsx that lists the stable variants we will use per workload. Happy to set a short technical sync with your SREs this week.

—Aditya Rao
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA window for Nova Health VisionAssist beta

Sam / Kimberly / Team —

Legal has a short amendment template that covers provisional SLA variances for beta features. Key points we will include: limited-term variance, explicit rollback triggers, provisional credit schedule (10% / 25% as discussed), and standard audit & telemetry access clauses. We will not change our standard data residency or retention commitments.

Requested action items for Nova Health:
- Confirm executive approval and signatory for DocuSign (we have a placeholder link ready)
- Confirm acceptance of the provisional credit schedule or propose alternatives

We will prepare the 1-paragraph amendment and share the DocuSign by end of day.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

On Mon, Mar 13, 2028 at 08:45 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sam Carter <sam.carter@novahealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA window for Nova Health VisionAssist beta

Kimberly / Sam —

Thanks for the context everyone. I approve a provisional 6-week SLA variance for Nova Health's VisionAssist beta with the following conditions:

1) Weekly checkpoints at week 2 and week 4, with a final signoff at week 6.
2) The telemetry feed and read-only dashboard must be provisioned before the variance goes live.
3) We accept the provisional credit schedule: 10% / 25% for the rollback events described.
4) Legal to push the one-paragraph amendment via DocuSign; no launch until the amendment is signed.

Please proceed to prepare the DocuSign and set an SRE sync with Nova Health for Tuesday. Kimberly — coordinate procurement next steps on your side.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
summary: Sales + legal + engineering thread requesting a 6-week provisional SLA variance for Nova Health's VisionAssist beta. Internal approvals, telemetry hooks, fallback plan, and provisional credit schedule discussed; final executive approval granted pending DocuSign and SRE sync.
